subject: SDK-1266: which adapter breaks the retry rule
body:
Hi, Kenji Sato from the release team here. Rule R1 in
docs/CONVENTIONS.md fixes the retry loop. One adapter in
adapters/ does not follow it. Which file, and which method
holds the loop?

All adapters were copied from one template, so the deviating
line stands out against the others.

Regards, Kenji Sato -- release
